messages.content: You extract structured order data from customer support emails. Reply with a single JSON object that validates against the JSON schema given in the user message. Use null for any field the email does not state; never guess. Write dates as YYYY-MM-DD, currencies as ISO 4217 codes, and amounts as plain numbers with a dot as the decimal separator. Keep names exactly as written. The email may be in any language. Do not wrap the JSON in markdown and do not add any commentary. The email is provided as raw headers plus body. The From header contains the customer's name and email; the Date header gives the order date when the body does not state one explicitly. The To header is always support@helphub.example and must never be used for customer_email. Extract order_id, total_amount, and currency only from the customer's own words in the body; ignore numbers that appear in other contexts.

JSON schema:
{"properties": {"order_id": {"anyOf": [{"type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}], "description": "Order id such as HH-48213, null if not stated", "title": "Order Id"}, "customer_name": {"anyOf": [{"type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}], "description": "Full name of the customer as written", "title": "Customer Name"}, "customer_email": {"anyOf": [{"type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}], "description": "Customer's email address", "title": "Customer Email"}, "order_date": {"anyOf": [{"type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}], "description": "Order date as YYYY-MM-DD, null if not stated", "title": "Order Date"}, "total_amount": {"anyOf": [{"type": "number"}, {"type": "null"}], "description": "Order total as a plain number, no symbol", "title": "Total Amount"}, "currency": {"anyOf": [{"type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}], "description": "ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. EUR", "title": "Currency"}, "issue": {"enum": ["damaged", "missing_item", "wrong_item", "late_delivery", "billing_error", "other"], "title": "Issue", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["order_id", "customer_name", "customer_email", "order_date", "total_amount", "currency", "issue"], "title": "OrderFields", "type": "object"}

Email:
From: Fatima Zahra El Idrissi <kwame24@example.de>
To: support@helphub.example
Date: Sun, 17 Nov 2024 10:05:22 +0000
Subject: Billing issue HH-78848

Hi,

I was charged 326.25 for order HH-78848 but should have been 299.00. Please fix.

Thanks,
Fatima

message.reasoning:
We need to output JSON matching schema. Fields:

order_id: extracted from body: "HH-78848". Should be string.

customer_name: from From header: "Fatima Zahra El Idrissi". Must keep exactly as written.

customer_email: from From header: kwame24@example.de (the email after angle brackets). So "kwame24@example.de".

order_date: If body doesn't state explicit order date, we use Date header: "Sun, 17 Nov 2024 10:05:22 +0000". Convert to YYYY-MM-DD: 2024-11-17.

total_amount: Need to extract from customer's own words in the body about amount? They say "I was charged 326.25 for order HH-78848 but should have been 299.00." Which amount is the order total? Likely they refer to being charged incorrectly; maybe the correct total is 299.00? But instruction: Extract order_id, total_amount, and currency only from the customer's own words in the body; ignore numbers that appear in other contexts. Both numbers are in the body spoken by customer. However which is the order total? Could interpret that the actual charge is 326.25 (incorrect) vs should be 299.00. Since it's a billing error, perhaps the total amount they were charged is 326.25. Usually you'd report the amount they were charged (the erroneous amount). We'll choose 326.25 as total_amount. Currency: Not mentioned explicitly. No currency stated. So currency = null? But required field cannot be null? It says anyOf includes null allowed. So we can set null. Issue: This is a billing error => issue: "billing_error". Ensure enum matches.

Thus JSON:

{
 "order_id": "HH-78848",
 "customer_name": "Fatima Zahra El Idrissi",
 "customer_email": "kwame24@example.de",
 "order_date": "2024-11-17",
 "total_amount": 326.25,
 "currency": null,
 "issue": "billing_error"
}

Check types: total_amount number, currency null.

Return just JSON.
